subtle_rules: A still life of one plain object from the work; never a person or a made-up software screen.
Soft paper ground, fine ink line and two grey tones; one small accent detail at most.
Calm light; no glow, gradients, 3D gloss, robots, brains or sparkles.
No words, logos, brand marks, customer names or faces of real people.
Every picture in a set is drawn the same way.
pictures.recipe: Quiet editorial still life of {object}, fine ink line drawing with two soft grey tones on warm off-white paper, a single small crimson (#b11f4b) ink detail on the object itself and nowhere else, object placed right of centre, at least 60% empty space on the left, calm even light, nothing else in the picture, no fruit, no plants, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no screens, no gradients.
